part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Traffic where you live
questions: How do most people travel to work where you live?
What traffic problems are there in your area? [Why?]
How do traffic problems affect you?
How would you reduce the traffic problems in your area?

part2.topic: Describe a game or sport you enjoy playing.
points: what kind of game or sport it is
part2.closing: and explain why you enjoy playing it.

topics.title: Children's games
questions: How have games changed from the time when you were a child?
Do you think this has been a positive change? Why?
Why do you think children like playing games?

topics.title: Games and competition
questions: Do you think competitive games are good or bad for children? In what ways?
How can games sometimes help to unite people?
Why is competition often seen as important in today's society?
